description: This file contains utility functions for making HTTP requests, handling responses, error transformation, and related helpers within the Notesnook project. It defines functions for GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE requests, error handling, and response processing.

classes.name: RequestError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling request-related errors, including error code, data, and description.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URL with optional authorization token.

methods.name: deleteRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified URL with optional authorization token.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with form data to the specified URL with optional token.

methods.name: patch.json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with JSON data to the specified URL with optional token.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with form data to the specified URL with optional token.

methods.name: post.json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON data to the specified URL with optional token.

methods.name: errorTransformer
methods.description: Transforms error JSON responses into a standardized error object with description, code, and data.

methods.name: fetchWrapped
methods.description: Wraps fetch call with error handling for network issues and provides custom error messages.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Processes fetch responses, parsing JSON or text, handling errors, and publishing events for unauthorized responses.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers with optional Bearer token for authorization.

methods.name: transformFormData
methods.description: Converts data object into URL-encoded form data string.
